content: {{recent}}, {{favorites}} and {{trash}} gather files from your rooms: recently opened, starred and deleted — the latter can still be restored. {{templates}} — your room templates. {{archive}} — rooms you no longer work in, restorable anytime.

comment.text: Informational text in a product tour step explaining various sidebar sections; includes placeholders representing specific navigation labels (Recent, Favorites, Trash, Templates, and Archive).
